body.message:
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.

As this apartment is in very high demand and is occupied almost continuously with back-to-back bookings, some signs of normal wear and tear may naturally occur despite our best efforts to maintain the property to a high standard.

If you would like, we would be happy to arrange an additional cleaning for the apartment to ensure your stay is as comfortable as possible. Please let us know, and we will be glad to assist you.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.
